name: Redstone Block Description
description: Learn redstone block functions directly from inventory tooltips. Hold Shift for scrollable details, comparator count tables, instrument and music-disc references, and 190 real in-game photos covering 233 vanilla items. Pin the guide with a configurable key (default H), jump through its contents, and pause or step through photos. Use /rbd on, off, toggle or status to control the help; your choice is saved. Korean and English. Client-only for Minecraft Java 26.2; requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API 0.160.0+26.2 and Java 25+. No server installation needed.
